$comment: Pinned copy of jadwigo-bank schemas/refusals.schema.json at bank commit 8e33c51. The bank's copy is the source of truth: change it there first, then re-copy here and update this commit.
title: Refusals
description: What people know about the items that do not play, per language: `refusals/<lang>.json at the bank repo root (what jw reads as <JADWIGO_BANK_DIR>/refusals/<lang>.json)` (dl-a38n.32.5, decisions dl-kaxj and dl-be2l). Each shape names the bead that fixes it; each flag pulls one item a person found wrong. Ids and reasons only, never question text, so it is safe in git.

shapes.description: A failing shape (one rule on one question type) and the bead that tracks its fix. A refused item in this shape carries the issue in its status.

rule.description: The render or check rule, as the conformance sidecar names it, e.g. render-overflow, key-grades

question_type.description: The spec's question_type; null for an item with none

issue.description: The bead id that fixes this shape

flags.description: An item a person pulled: it is flagged whatever the checks say, until the flag is removed.

by.description: Who pulled it: a role or session, never a family member's name

reason.description: Why, in a few words, without quoting the question

issue.description: The bead that tracks the fix, when there is one

on.description: The day it was pulled, YYYY-MM-DD
